title: ARAA Agent Registration
description: A registration file for one agent, stored at registry/agents/<agent_id>.json.

agent_id.description: A unique ID in kebab-case. It must match the file name.

framework.description: Framework the agent is built on, e.g. LangChain, AutoGPT or Custom.

operator_github.description: GitHub username of the human operator responsible for the agent.

statement.description: A short statement of intent, written by the agent.

public_key_pem.description: Optional public key (PEM), e.g. one generated by tools/induction.py.
